# joint_agreements

Shared-capital arrangement terms and their current assessment/version.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="joint_agreements", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="joint_agreements", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters: exact equality only.** Operator objects are literal values here; they do not implement in/contains/ranges.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Explicit identifier relationships

- `assessment_case_id` references a `service_cases` record ID when present. See `DB-service_cases`.
- `assessment_booking_id` references a `service_bookings` record ID when present. See `DB-service_bookings`.
- `fee_source_id` references a `joint_sources` record ID when present. See `DB-joint_sources`.

Commercial references can require entity, period or issuer matching. An ID relationship does not imply that every related record repeats the same case_id.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assessment_booking_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in service_bookings. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `assessment_case_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in service_cases. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `assessment_seq` | integer | Top-level filter | Audit sequence at which the assessment was recorded, not elapsed time. |
| `assessment_status` | string | Top-level filter | Assessment status: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `capital_by_account` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Map from destination account-record IDs to capital amounts; use the agreement's account routing terms. |
| `capital_by_case` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Map from service_cases IDs to contractual total capital amounts in minor units; read capital_delivery_mode and the agreement terms to interpret the obligation. |
| `capital_delivery_mode` | string | Top-level filter | Capital delivery mode: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `continuous_floor_by_case` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Map from service_cases IDs to operating cash floors that apply continuously, in minor units. |
| `currency` | string | Top-level filter | Currency code for the associated monetary fields. Preserve separate currency balances. Public values represented here: `USD`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `customer_access` | boolean | Top-level filter | Record visibility flag used by the environment; it does not confer transaction authority. |
| `fee_cadence` | string | Top-level filter | Fee cadence: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `fee_source_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in joint_sources. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `funding_deadline` | integer | Top-level filter | Logical minute deadline stated in the capital agreement. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `initial_operating_by_account` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Initial operating cash assigned to each destination account, in minor units. |
| `initial_operating_by_case` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Map from service_cases IDs to cash already placed in those wallets at the start; these amounts are included in the agreement's total capital figures. |
| `maximum_delivery_fees_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Maximum delivery fees amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `minimum_uncommitted_cash_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Minimum uncommitted cash amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `name` | string | Top-level filter | Human-readable name. Names need not be unique; exact filters are case-sensitive. |
| `no_capital_recall` | boolean | Top-level filter | No capital recall: true/false state flag for this record. |
| `possible_assessed_fees` | array | Top-level filter | Public possible assessed charge schedule; current applicable fees are on the assessed route records. |
| `reserve_with_earmarked_source` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Reserve with earmarked source: structured business data. Named nested fields are listed below when present; maps retain their own key/value meaning. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `terms_version` | integer | Top-level filter | Version of the terms used by this object or booking; requests may bind a specific version. |


## Record keys and joins

| Intended lookup | Collection | Key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read the capital agreement itself | joint_agreements | id; get_record takes that value as record_id |
| Find its funding sources, delivery routes or posted fundings | joint_sources, joint_routes, joint_fundings | agreement_id equals the returned joint_agreements.id |
| Read a service enquiry itself | service_cases | id |
| Find typed records or operation receipts for that enquiry | service_records, service_bookings | case_id equals service_cases.id, where declared for the record type |
| Filter an access namespace | Collections documenting scope | scope; it is neither an agreement ID nor a service case ID |

joint_agreements does not have an agreement_id field. A field ending in _id is only a join when its collection dictionary documents the target. For all get_record calls, use an ID returned by a query or an explicit reference.
